question: Which one of these classical musicians is credited with popularizing the sitar in the global music scene?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pandit Ravi Shankar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Pandit Ravi Shankar** is globally recognized for popularizing the **sitar**, a classical Indian musical instrument, on the international stage.
 
• He collaborated with prominent Western musicians, including **George Harrison** of The Beatles, which introduced Indian classical music to a global audience.
 
• Pandit Ravi Shankar performed at renowned global events such as the **Monterey Pop Festival** in 1967 and **Woodstock** in 1969, showcasing the sitar and Indian music to diverse audiences.
 
• He received several prestigious awards, including **Grammy Awards**, and was honored with the **Bharat Ratna**, India's highest civilian award, in 1999.
 
• Through his virtuosity and global collaborations, Ravi Shankar elevated the sitar to an iconic status in world music, making Indian classical music accessible and appreciated internationally.
